subject: Cloud marketplace annual renewal checklist & fee alignment
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@marketplaceconsulting.com>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-25 09:12 PDT
Subject: Draft fee schedule + renewal checklist for your review

Hi Nikhil —

Attached is the v3 fee schedule and a short renewal checklist I promised on our call. Key items to scan:
- Proposed listing fee band changes for AWS (net to Redwood after credits) in tab "AWS_v3"
- Suggested language for co-sell incentive carve-outs (tab "CoSell")
- Draft scope for the SOW amendment to extend listing through 2028

My read: AWS will be firm on the 12% baseline but there are levers (marketing credits, co-sell uplift, program credits) we can negotiate to keep net effective fee closer to 6–8% for our enterprise deals. GCP is more flexible on promotional credits but wants stronger commit volumes.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Internal alignment on target net fee by region (can you confirm US target by Tue?)
2) I’ll convert the SOW draft to a redline we can share with marketplaces once we’ve aligned numbers
3) Schedule a micro-call with AWS partner ops and our legal (20–30m) — I’ve tentatively proposed Wed morning.

Attaching: 3 files. Let me know if you want me to join the internal sync.

Best,
Sarah Patel
Principal, Marketplace Consulting LLP
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment stubs: 2027-09-25-Marketplace-Fee-Schedule-v3.xlsx (xlsx), SOW-Listing-Renewal-Draft-Redwood.pdf (pdf), Marketplaces-annual-checklist.md (md)

From: nikhil_sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: sarah@marketplaceconsulting.com, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-25 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Draft fee schedule + renewal checklist for your review

Thanks Sarah — quick internal note for alignment.

Marissa / Laura —
Can you each call out a recommended target net fee we should try to achieve for US listings (target = effective fee after credits) and one line on acceptable trade-offs (e.g., 12% baseline + $X marketing credits OR 8% net with 18m commit). My initial target: 7% net in US, with willingness to accept up to 9% if we secure multi-market co-sell credits and a 12–18 month marketing fund.

Vivek — please confirm whether finance is comfortable taking an extended commit (18m) to lower fee bands; if not we should build a fallback.

Also, Sarah — please hold the SOW redline until Marissa and Laura confirm targets; we want one number to negotiate from.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Draft fee schedule + renewal checklist for your review

Nikhil —

Quick bullets from GTM POV:
- Target net fee (US): 7.5% (conservative), stretch to 6% if we secure a combined $1.2M marketing credit across AWS+GCP and co-sell uplift of +15% SQL coverage.
- Trade-offs: Longer commit (18 months) ok but prefer quarterly step-downs tied to verified usage (so we reduce risk on volume miss).
- Required ask from sales: ability to route 30% of eligible pipeline through marketplace SKUs for 12 months to qualify for co-sell uplift.

I'll mock a short internal note we can share with finance/legal.

-M
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, GTM Partnerships
marissa_cole@redwood.com

On Fri, Sep 25, 2027 at 09:12 AM Sarah Patel <sarah@marketplaceconsulting.com> wrote:

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, sarah@marketplaceconsulting.com
Date: 2027-09-28 10:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Draft fee schedule + renewal checklist for your review

Nikhil / team —

Finance read: Vivek and I ran the baseline with product/finance scenarios. Short summary:
- 7% net is feasible only if we get ~$950k marketing credits + co-sell uplift assumptions realized.
- If we only get marketing credits from GCP but not AWS, expected net drifts to ~10.5% in year 1.
- 18-month commit reduces unit economics risk but requires a mid-term usage review clause and opt-down triggers if usage < 70% projection for two consecutive quarters.

Vivek: please confirm if we want finance to model the opt-down clause and provide a revenue recognition note for legal.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations (PMM partnership lead)
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: AWS Partner Team <aws-partner@amazon.com>
To: nikhil_sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: sarah@marketplaceconsulting.com
Date: 2027-09-30 15:12 PDT
Subject: Re: Draft fee schedule + renewal checklist for your review

Hi Nikhil / Marissa —

Thanks for the context and the spreadsheet. A few quick points from partner ops:
- Baseline listing fee remains 12% gross. We can offer marketing fund offsets up to 4% effective for FY28 if you commit to co-marketing tiers (evidence of spend required).
- Co-sell uplift program: we can approve a +12% uplift on qualified opportunities if joint pipeline routing and deal registration are in place.
- We are willing to accept an 18-month commit if you include a mid-term review clause; opt-down language must include a 60–90 day notice and documented remediation plan.

I can join your Wed internal micro-call; propose Wed 10:30am PT.

Regards,
Angela Chu
AWS Marketplace Partner Ops
aws-partner@amazon.com

Date: 2027-09-30 16:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Draft fee schedule + renewal checklist for your review

Thanks Angela — appreciate the clarity.

We can tentatively accept: 12% baseline + up to 4% marketing offset (contingent on evidence of joint spend) + co-sell uplift terms you outlined, with an 18-month commitment and a mid-term review clause.

Action items before the call:
- Sarah: please produce a redline SOW that reflects the 18m commit + mid-term review clause and the marketing fund measurement mechanism (by EOD Mon).
- Marissa: prepare a 1-pager on routing requirements so AWS can validate co-sell qualification criteria.
- Laura / Vivek: draft the opt-down triggers (usage thresholds and notice windows) and revenue recognition impact for legal.

I’ll run the Wed 10:30am PT micro-call and invite Legal once we have the redline. If anything changes I’ll update the HubSpot deal.

Thanks all —
Nikhil
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
